section.heading: When a person is in a position to exercise control of a facility

content.p: (1) For the purposes of this Part, a person (the first person) is in a position to exercise control of a facility if:
the first person legally or beneficially owns the facility (whether alone or together with one or more other persons); or
the first person is in a position, either alone or together with an associate of the first person and whether directly or indirectly:
to exercise control of the operation of all or part of the facility; or
to exercise control of the selection of the kinds of services that are supplied using the facility; or
to exercise control of the supply of services using the facility; or
a company other than the first person legally or beneficially owns the facility (whether alone or together with one or more other persons), and:
the first person is in a position, either alone or together with an associate of the first person, to exercise control of the company; or
the first person, either alone or together with an associate of the first person, is in a position to veto any action taken by the board of directors of the company; or

the first person, either alone or together with an associate of the first person, is in a position to appoint or secure the appointment of, or veto the appointment of, at least half of the board of directors of the company; or

the first person, either alone or together with an associate of the first person, is in a position to exercise, in any other manner, whether directly or indirectly, direction or restraint over any substantial issue affecting the management or affairs of the company; or

the company or more than 50% of its directors act, or are accustomed to act, in accordance with the directions, instructions or wishes of, or in concert with, the first person, the first person and an associate of the first person acting together, or the directors of the first person; or

the company or more than 50% of its directors, under a contract or an arrangement or understanding (whether formal or informal), are intended or expected to act in accordance with the directions, instructions or wishes of, or in concert with, the first person, the first person and an associate of the first person acting together, or the directors of the first person.

An employee is not, except through an association with another person, to be regarded as being in a position to exercise control of a facility under subsection (1) purely because of being an employee.
More than one person may be in a position to exercise control of a facility.

content.p: For the purposes of this Part, if a provisional nominated service area is attributable to a declaration under this section, so much of the provisional nominated service area as is not:

is a nominated service area.
Provisional nominated service area—real estate development project
If:
on or after 1 July 2024, a facility is installed in, or in proximity to, the project area of a real estate development project; and
the facility is not part of the infrastructure of a telecommunications network; and
there is no nominated service area that:
consists of, or includes, the project area; and
is attributable to a declaration under section 360H or this section; and

to supply carriage services to end-users at premises in the whole or a part of the project area; or

any of the following conditions is satisfied:
the first carriage service provider is in a position to exercise control of the facility;
the first carriage service provider is an associate of a person who is in a position to exercise control of the facility;

the first carriage service provider has entered into a contractual arrangement with the person responsible for the real estate development project, where the contractual arrangement relates to the facility; and
the conditions specified in an instrument under subsection (3) are satisfied;
the first carriage service provider must:
(g) by written instrument, declare that the whole or the part, as the case requires, of the project area is a provisional nominated service area for the purposes of this Part; and
do so within 20 business days after the relevant time.

Subdivision C—Remedial notices
Scope
This section applies if the ACMA reasonably believes that a person:
is contravening a designated civil penalty provision; or
has contravened a designated civil penalty provision in circumstances that make it likely that the contravention will continue or be repeated; or
is likely to contravene a designated civil penalty provision.
Note: For designated civil penalty provision, see section 372JH.
Remedial notice
The ACMA may give the person a written notice requiring the person to:
remedy the contravention; or
prevent the likely contravention from occurring; or
remedy the things or operations causing the contravention or likely contravention.
(3) A notice under subsection (2) is to be known as a remedial notice.
A remedial notice given to a person by the ACMA must state:
that the ACMA reasonably believes that the person:
is contravening a designated civil penalty provision; or
has contravened a designated civil penalty provision in circumstances that make it likely that the contravention will continue or be repeated; or
is likely to contravene a designated civil penalty provision; and
the provision the ACMA believes is being, has been, or is likely to be, contravened; and
briefly, how the provision is being, has been, or is likely to be, contravened; and
the period within which the person must comply with the notice.
Note: For designated civil penalty provision, see section 372JH.

remedy the contravention; or
prevent the likely contravention from occurring; or
remedy the things or operations causing the contravention or likely contravention.
The period stated for compliance with the remedial notice must be reasonable in all the circumstances.
A person must comply with a remedial notice.

A person must not:
aid, abet, counsel or procure a contravention of subsection (1); or
induce, whether by threats or promises or otherwise, a contravention of subsection (1); or
be in any way, directly or indirectly, knowingly concerned in, or party to, a contravention of subsection (1); or
conspire with others to effect a contravention of subsection (1).
Civil penalty provisions

section.heading: Extension of time for compliance with remedial notices
